search_engines.name: Startpage
search_engines.text: A privacy-first search engine which doesn't profile or track you. Startpage Privacy-focused. Relies on Google and Bing for results. Promises not to track or profile you.

search_engines.name: Kagi
search_engines.text: A privacy-first search engine which doesn't profile or track you. Kagi Ad-free search with custom ranking. Requires a Kagi account and a paid subscription after the trial. Select Kagi to make it your default search engine.

search_engines.name: DuckDuckGo
search_engines.text: A privacy-first search engine which doesn't profile or track you. DuckDuckGo Privacy-focused. Relies on Bing for results. Promises not to track or profile you.

search_engines.name: Brave Search
search_engines.text: A privacy-first search engine which doesn't profile or track you. Brave Search Privacy-focused. Doesn't use Google or Bing. Promises not to track or profile you. May show promotions related to Brave services.

search_engines.name: Ecosia
search_engines.text: Transparent, but not privacy-focused. Offers better privacy than mainstream search engines. Ecosia May plant trees for clicking ads. Relies on Google and Bing for results. Sends tracking data to Google and Microsoft.

search_engines.name: Qwant
search_engines.text: Transparent, but not privacy-focused. Offers better privacy than mainstream search engines. Qwant Based in Europe. Relies on Bing for results. Sends tracking data to Microsoft.

search_engines.name: Google
search_engines.text: A mainstream search engine which collects extensive personal data. Google It's Google. It dominates the search market, collects extensive personal data, and profiles you.

search_engines.text: A mainstream search engine which collects extensive personal data. Microsoft Bing Collects extensive personal data. Privacy controls are buried and limited. Subjectively overwhelming UI.

ui.services_provider_disclosure:
Helium services

Lune uses services hosted by Helium for extension downloads, !bangs, filter lists, dictionaries, and component updates.

Allow connecting to Helium services

Allow Lune to connect to Helium-hosted services. Choosing Next confirms these settings.

Allow automatic Helium services updates

Automatically download and install updates to Lune-provided browser components.

Proxy extension downloads and updates

When enabled, Lune will proxy extension downloads and updates to protect your privacy. When disabled, downloading and updating extensions will not work.

Allow downloading the !bangs list

Lune will fetch a list of bangs that help you browse the Internet faster, such as !w or !gh. When disabled, bangs will not work.

Allow downloading filter lists for uBlock Origin

Lune will fetch fresh filter lists for uBlock Origin. All requests to lists are proxied to protect your privacy. When disabled, default filter lists will be loaded from local storage, which are only updated along with Lune. Optional filter lists will be requested without proxying.

Use your own instance of Helium services

You can host your own Helium services instance and select it in Lune settings.

service_provider.disclosure: When enabled, Lune will be able to connect to anonymous web services to provide additional functionality. When disabled, additional features will not work.
